content:
Elena SRE: FYI ap-south2 apiserver 502/504 spike starting 09:07 UTC, controller-manager showing attach/detach churn for the rtx-pool. alerts: apiserver_5xx_rate and controller_attach_fail_rate. :rotating_light:
Arjun Infra: looking at cloud NAT logs — SNAT ephemeral port exhaustion around 09:05. lots of NAT translations in TIME_WAIT, new flows being dropped.
Kai Eng: that would explain `i/o timeout` in etcd RPCs if responses can't get back. grabbing apiserver/etcd snippets.
Elena SRE: here's the apiserver log excerpt:
```
E0615 09:06:12.442 apiserver.go:512] http2: server: read timeout from 10.4.12.7:50322: i/o timeout
E0615 09:06:12.443 etcd: clientv3: grpc: the client connection is closing
```
Arjun Infra: NAT stats show ephemeral ports used per nodepool hitting 65530 around that time. We had a burst of attach ops (CSI) that opened many concurrent connections to remote provider APIs and the control plane.
Kai Eng: controller-manager attach errors:
```
E0615 09:06:15.112 controller-manager: AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "vol-xyz" : rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
I0615 09:06:15.120 controller-manager: requeue attach for pod xyz
```
Elena SRE: mitigation ideas: 1) reduce controller-manager concurrent attaches on affected clusters (safe defaults), 2) scale NAT pool (more ephemeral ports) or use SNAT per-node, 3) add exponential backoff on attach controller. Which do we want first?
Arjun Infra: I can enlarge NAT pool and flip to per-node SNAT for the rtx nodepool. Rolling now. Also toggling TCP reuse settings to help TIME_WAIT reuse.
PagerBot: [action] Created incident INC-2026-3007 severity=high owner=Arjun Infra notify=#oncall.
Marta Finance: FYI attach retries are billable on provider — early estimate: ~$600 for the 25-minute window. Please include billing impact in postmortem.
Kai Eng: applying canary patch to controller-manager: `--concurrent-attaches=6` and `--attach-detach-reconcile-sync-period=150s` on one replica.
Elena SRE: also temporarily routing control-plane reads to eu-west1 for non-strong-consistency endpoints to reduce etcd read load. Coordinating with Arjun.
Arjun Infra: NAT pool expanded, per-node SNAT enabled for rtx nodes, and tcp_tw_reuse set. Verifying metrics.
Kai Eng: canary shows leader election stabilized and attach failures dropping within 90s. apiserver 5xx trending down.
PagerBot: [update] INC-2026-3007 severity=degraded -> investigating.
Elena SRE: short-term actions: finish NAT config roll, roll controller-manager safe defaults globally, add attach-rate alert to catch similar spikes, and include finance impact. Long-term: consider client-side connection pooling for CSI driver and rate-limit attach operations at scheduler.
Marta Finance: will work with ops for exact billing breakdown and notify affected customers if there's user-visible latency.
Arjun Infra: NAT rollout complete for rtx nodepool at 09:32 UTC, post-change check: ephemeral_port_utilization < 20%.
Kai Eng: 09:33 UTC apiserver 5xx back to baseline, attach queue cleared, controller-manager stopped restarting. Keeping canary for 15m.
Elena SRE: postmortem action owner list: Arjun (NAT + SNAT per-node), Kai (controller-manager defaults + attach backoff), Elena (alerts + customer comms), Marta (billing). Thanks team. :thumbsup:
